seoTitle: Capital Row: receive a valuation, and know the earnings behind it
seoDescription: The Pre-Market Assessment: an indicative valuation range, the earnings behind it and a 90-day plan, for owners who want to grow now and keep their options open.

sections.name: Know what your business is worth. Before you go to market.

items.text: Know what your business is worth. Before you go to market.

The Pre-Market Assessment gives you an indicative valuation range, the earnings behind it and a 90-day plan to strengthen both. Three working sessions and one written assessment. You do not need to have decided to sell.

sections.name: A valuation range, and the reasons behind it.

items.text: A valuation range, and the reasons behind it.
A range, not a single number, with the assumptions behind it written down.
Your adjusted earnings as you report them, and the adjustments a buyer is most likely to question.
The findings a buyer’s diligence is most likely to raise, in order of their effect on value.
What to work on over the next ninety days, in order.
The valuation range is an indicative estimate for your own planning. It is not an appraisal or a fairness opinion, and it is not prepared for a lender, a tax filing or a court.
